prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished, flat, opaque 16:9 landscape event poster for an adult neighborhood upcycling-and-sharing hobby workshop, shown on a community cultural-center digital screen. Approachably sociable, confident adult daytime culture, with a clear newcomer invitation. This is one independent poster, not a mockup, framed scene, contact sheet or multi-poster comparison.

Whole visual system: a broadside in flat high-contrast stencil/ink graphics. Warm light cream-grey background, near-black upright typography, charcoal cotton shirt and remade pouch with burnt-orange textile geometry, a muted-blue second pouch. Crisp matte ink edges, decisive negative space, very sparse halftone confined to the cloth or palm shapes to describe form. No all-over grit, tape, scraps, gloss, clay, extruded/raised letters, gradients, decorative stars, logos, QR, watermark, fake microprint or any added wording.

Composition, expressed at a 720×405 viewing scale and proportionally enlarged for the output: masthead left edge x24, top y16, generous upper interval, 56px bold wide Helvetica-like plain English. Below, Korean identity at x24/y106, 40px firm bold Korean sans, naturally split after its third word into two lines with 48px pitch. Activity x24/y218, 22px semibold, naturally wrap immediately after the middle dot into two lines with 29px pitch. Compact substantive picture occupies upper-right x397/y102, width323 and height143, ending at the right edge. Lower-left attendance is one contiguous usable group x24/y288 through394: date and time share the first row, with time starting x221; venue on next row y324; entrance on next y360. These use 24px semibold and must fit without collision. Lower-right participation/preparation is one complete longer block x397/y260 through390, 19px clear regular Korean sans, four distinct single-line facts at 32px pitch. Keep the left attendance larger and lower than the right facts, not equal footer tiles. Shared text edges lead from masthead through identity/activity to attendance; the right picture sits directly above its useful complete participation block. No text goes on the objects or palms. All practical copy must be readily readable at the 720px-wide screen view, with intact Hangul proportions, open counters, word spaces, punctuation and safe margins.

Picture: one cohesive source/result/offering emblem, not three boxes and not a tiny decorative icon. At its left, an unmistakable charcoal T-shirt with collar, both sleeves and bounded usable torso. Two broad burnt-orange torso bands have an offset rectangular notch and a reinforced lower edge; these are original NON-letter textile geometry, not a print or writing. Beside it, a smaller rectangular completed charcoal pouch carries the SAME ordered two bands, offset notch and reinforced front/base edge INSIDE its sewn edges; its new shape lacks collar/sleeves, and has a clearly readable functional zipper mouth and seam. This correspondence is visible in the actual geometry, not only matching colors. The completed charcoal pouch rests clearly on a broad adult palm arriving from lower-left; opposite it, a second distinct muted-blue completed pouch rests on another broad adult palm arriving from the right. Two separately traceable wrists/palms, one supporting each object, face inward in a reciprocal offering. Keep pouches, mouths, seams, palm contacts and the gap between them separate and visible. Flat stencil simplification is intentional; no tangled fingers, unsupported pouch, magical cloth flow, arrows, flying torso panels, or concurrent sewing operations. The source/result resemblance and two completed offerings visibly connect remaking the worn shirt with sharing finished pouches.

Only the following eleven supplied entries are printed, each exactly once, in their assigned role. Preserve exact spelling, word spaces, capitalization, punctuation including the time en dash, colons, comma, date dots and middle dots. Natural layout line breaks are allowed; do not change words or add labels.
Masthead: "REMAKE & SHARE"
Korean identity: "입던 옷의 다음 장면"
Activity: "티셔츠를 파우치로 · 완성품 나눔"
Attendance first-row date: "2027.01.16 토요일"
Attendance first-row time: "14:00–16:30"
Attendance second row: "성산 생활문화센터"
Attendance third row: "13:40부터 입장"
Right block first line: "참가비 3,000원 · 도구 제공"
Right block second line: "사전 신청 · 정원 18명"
Right block third line: "깨끗한 티셔츠 한 장 지참"
Right block fourth line: "바느질이 처음이어도 괜찮아요"

Output one full-bleed opaque horizontal poster in the requested 16:9 width:height ratio, with no border or surrounding scene. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
